maddeler.e:
أنبطح (form VII)
# أَنْبَطِحُ (ʔanbaṭiḥu) /ʔan.ba.tˤi.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# أَنْبَطِحَ (ʔanbaṭiḥa) /ʔan.ba.tˤi.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# أَنْبَطِحْ (ʔanbaṭiḥ) /ʔan.ba.tˤiħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
